meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从命令行制作演示动画
copy.tagline_en: Create and render presentation animations from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build presentations programmatically.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 npx hyperframes 命令来管理视频项目：初始化、检查、渲染、发布等，并在构建或渲染失败时进行诊断。
howto.when: 当用户要求执行 HyperFrames 相关操作（如初始化、检查、渲染）或诊断构建/渲染失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目用 hyperframes 初始化一下。
say.note: 运行 init 创建项目结构。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes check 检查我的项目。
say.note: 执行最终检查，包含 lint。

say.text: 用 hyperframes 渲染成 mp4 视频。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to use the HyperFrames CLI (npx hyperframes) to manage video projects: init, check, render, publish, etc., and to diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for HyperFrames operations (e.g., init, check, render) or when diagnosing build/render failures.

say_en.note: Runs init to scaffold the project.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes check on my project.
say_en.note: Runs the final gate, including lint.

say_en.text: Render this to mp4 with hyperframes.
say_en.note: Executes the render and outputs the file.
